Tara (marketing): Ops raised an incident in eu-central. We need quick alignment: status page headline, email threshold, and a short social pointer. Keep it non-technical and consistent.
Ben (ops): We're seeing elevated error rates for embeddings in eu-central. Plan: post 'investigating' within 10m; if unresolved at 30m, send email. I'll drop a quick ops summary for edits.
Rita (support): I'll prep two canned replies (short + long) and a one-liner for account teams. Also confirm: avoid the term 'outage' unless verified.
Sam (product): Note for private deployments: not affected unless they map to eu-central. I'll send the list of impacted customer clusters.
Ivy (legal): Keep promises conditional. Don't make SLA commitments in the initial email. I'll standby to review subject lines.
Migs (growth): Social: one tweet linking to statuspage only. No proactive PR. If it goes >2h, we prepare a short customer note offering office hours.
Ben (ops): Draft status copy: "Investigating increased errors for embeddings in eu-central. Some requests may fail or return errors. Our engineers are investigating; we will update with ETA soon." Please tweak.
Tara (marketing): Tweak: Start with "We're aware of an issue affecting embeddings in eu-central" then bullets: impact, affected customers, what we're doing, next update. Email subject option: "Redwood: Issue affecting embeddings in eu-central".
Rita (support): I'll upload canned replies and a CS FAQ (retry patterns, when to escalate) to the playbook and link here.
Ben (ops): Signal thresholds: status <=10m, email at 30m, account outreach at 2h for top 20. I'll post ops:send-email in #ops if it hits 30m.
Tara (marketing): Action list: ops -> post draft + signal (Ben), marketing -> finalize email & social templates (Tara + Migs), support -> canned replies (Rita), legal -> final review (Ivy), product -> impacted cluster list (Sam). I'll post templates here in 20m.
